effectSummary.ko: 서리 구체가 최대 8m를 초속 5m로 날아가 지정 지점이나 첫 벽에서 시전 위치로 돌아옵니다. 왕복 각각 최대 5명에게 한 번씩 D90% 냉기 피해와 3초간 35% 둔화를 줍니다. 돌아올 때 이미 둔화된 적은 0.75초 빙결됩니다. 구체 도착 순간 시전 위치 0.7m 안에 있으면 마나 12를 한 번 회수합니다. 벽이 귀환을 막으면 회수에 실패합니다.
effectSummary.en: Send a frost globe up to 8m at 5m/s, then return from its aim point or first wall to the cast location. Each leg hits up to 5 enemies once for D90% cold damage and a 35% slow for 3s. Returning hits freeze already slowed enemies for 0.75s. Restore 12 mana once if within 0.7m of the cast location when it arrives. A blocked return misses recovery.

prompt: Create one square HELLSCRIPT dark fantasy RPG skill icon for M10 (Mage). Main subject: one luminous blue-white frost sphere flying on a bold curved returning ice trail shaped like a boomerang toward a small cyan rune anchor, unmistakable return path with one outward and one inward arc. Painterly premium game ability icon, strong sculpted silhouette, weathered iron and focused luminous magical accent, restrained dark desaturated colors, dramatic readable highlights. Composition must remain unmistakable at 64 by 64 pixels. One isolated centered icon subject fills about 85 percent of the square; no decorative circular medallion, no border, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no additional unrelated weapons. Deliver a transparent PNG with preserved native alpha. All surrounding space and internal empty spaces fully transparent; no scenery, no solid backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no frame, no unwanted shadow. Keep wispy effects minimal and clean at small size. Do not add an opaque background.

notes.ko: 새 전투 컨셉의 주체와 방향이 64px에서도 구별됩니다. 밝은·어두운 배경에서 투명 여백과 내부 빈 공간, 주요 실루엣을 확인했습니다.
notes.en: The new mechanic silhouette and direction remain distinct at 64px. Reviewed transparent margins, internal gaps and primary shapes on light and dark backgrounds.

reuseReason: Existing GlobalHUD icons are 256px line symbols with UI plates, unsuitable as these 1024px painterly masters.
